$comment: Module registry for scripts/module_context.mjs. roots own all files under them (longest prefix wins); layer follows contract < domain < app < orchestration < shell < ui vocabulary.

modules.role: Leaf contracts: domain settings schemas, platform paths, logger, action risk, shared types & utils
modules.notes: Strict leaf package (depcruise core-is-a-leaf): zero internal package dependencies.

modules.role: Base46 theme tokens, presets, and compiler
Static system prompt slot assembler (persona, planPrompt, extraPrompt, transcriptSystem) & dynamic <system_reminder> formatter
File-backed persistence: JSON collections, TOML settings/models, thread run locks
Append-only SessionEvent JSONL log, event replay & thread forking
Model-neutral transcript types, chronological UI <-> ModelMessage projection, tool payload contracts, HTTP/proxy helpers
modules.notes: Pure protocol/projection layer: depends only on @iki/core and @iki/system-prompt (no store/session/vendor deps).

modules.role: Model supply adapter (@earendil-works/pi-ai): factory, capability resolution, model discovery, auxiliary tool-model selection
modules.notes: Leaf provider adapter — must not reach up into tools, session, harness, or shells (depcruise provider-is-leaf).

modules.role: Tool & step contracts (BaseTool, ToolRegistry, AgentStep, AgentHooks)
Pure multi-step tool-calling loop engine (runAgentLoop)
Pluggable built-in tools (@iki/tools/shell bash/pwsh/job, @iki/tools/swarm)
Turn orchestration: session loop, streaming, approval persistence, recovery, compaction, mailbox, session-log authority
modules.notes: The durable-execution core. Protected by packages/harness/README.md and HARNESS_REVIEW.md.

modules.role: Turn harnesses, context budget, compaction step, tool resolution & execution
Pre-turn assembly: context blocks, project instructions, tool guard, prompt inputs
modules.notes: thread_session reaches turn_prep only via injected ports (depcruise turn-prep-below-session).

modules.role: Multi-agent swarm orchestration: shared append-only board, roster, role prompts, worktree workers
Host tool wiring, skills discovery & cache-safe delta reminders
MCP server lifecycle, transports, remote tool registration
Continue-later wakes: awaiter manager, schedule, wake runs
Workspace selection, Git worktree isolation driver, thread approval-policy parsing
Harness composition config, auxiliary runtimes (summary/compaction prompt), and shared invocation types
Fullscreen pi-tui interactive REPL, live Swarm/Job watch views, and --print/--json CLI
Electron shell: IPC translate layer, preload bridge, shared ElectronApi contract, windows, platform services
Vue 3 SPA: components, composables, stores, chat module. electronAPI is the only backend door.
modules.notes: Imports only pure types/utils (depcruise renderer-backend-whitelist & renderer-no-schema-heavy-closure).
